result.instructions: Tools for GovDelivery, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which topics do we have in GovDelivery, and how many subscribers does each have?"; "Is jane.doe@example.org subscribed to the planning-updates topic?"; "Draft a bulletin about the council meeting on Tuesday for the newsletter topic.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes GovDelivery data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run govdelivery_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run govdelivery_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run govdelivery_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. govdelivery_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: govdelivery_list_topics
tools.title: List topics
tools.description: List the topics of the GovDelivery account (their codes and names). Topic codes are needed for subscriptions and bulletins. Read-only. GovDelivery REST: GET /api/account/{account}/topics.

tools.name: govdelivery_get_subscriber
tools.title: Get subscriber
tools.description: Read one subscriber by email address: their topic subscriptions and record fields, as GovDelivery returns them (XML). Read-only. GovDelivery REST: GET /api/account/{account}/subscribers/{base64 email}.xml.

email.description: The subscriber's email address, e.g. person@example.org.

tools.name: govdelivery_get_bulletin
tools.title: Get bulletin
tools.description: Read one bulletin by id: subject, state (draft or sent), topics and total subscribers, as GovDelivery returns them (XML). Read-only. Bulletin ids come from the bulletin you created or from GovDelivery. GovDelivery REST: GET /api/account/{account}/bulletins/{id}.xml.

bulletin_id.description: The bulletin id, e.g. the id of a draft from govdelivery_create_bulletin_draft or of a bulletin in GovDelivery.

tools.name: govdelivery_set_subscriber_topics
tools.title: Set subscriber topics
tools.description: WRITE: adds ONE subscriber to topics, or REPLACES that subscriber's topic subscriptions with exactly the codes given (GovDelivery 'replace or create'), so topics not listed may be removed. Use only for a person who opted in to these topics; never for purchased or scraped lists. Set send_notifications true only when the subscriber should receive a notice. GovDelivery REST: POST /api/account/{account}/subscriptions.xml.

send_notifications.description: Email the subscriber that their record changed. Default false.

tools.name: govdelivery_create_bulletin_draft
tools.title: Create bulletin draft
tools.description: WRITE: creates a DRAFT bulletin for the given topics. Nothing is sent: the draft waits in GovDelivery until govdelivery_send_bulletin sends it. Subject: plain text, max 400 characters; GovDelivery advises against special characters such as ! or quotes because spam filters may flag them (advice only, not enforced). Body: HTML or plain text. Open and click tracking are off. GovDelivery REST: POST /api/account/{account}/bulletins.xml.

body.description: The bulletin body: HTML or plain text (max 200000 characters).

tools.name: govdelivery_send_bulletin
tools.title: Send bulletin
tools.description: WRITE: SENDS an existing DRAFT bulletin by email to every subscriber of its topics, now. This cannot be undone. Set confirm_send to true only after the user has approved this exact bulletin in this conversation. A sent bulletin cannot be sent again. GovDelivery REST: POST /api/account/{account}/bulletins/{id}/send_now.

bulletin_id.description: The id of the DRAFT bulletin to send (from govdelivery_create_bulletin_draft).

confirm_send.description: Must be true. Confirms that this call sends real email to real subscribers now.
